description: Explain a vendor error message using the vendor's reference page (Paperlane Print). DISTILL-CANARY-6343cf89

web_fixture.title: Printer fault B18
web_fixture.content:
# Fault B18

Carriage jam detected. Power off, open the rear cover and remove any paper scraps from the rail. Do not pull the carriage by hand while powered. If B18 returns after cleaning, the encoder strip needs replacing (part PE-44).

web_fixture.title: Printer fault B81
web_fixture.content:
# Fault B81

Ink waste pad nearly full. Service required.

turns.prompt: My Paperlane printer shows B18. What does it mean and what should I try first?
